description: Golden SQL pairs for ratings, customer reviews, verified purchase status, and community helpfulness votes.

sql_pairs.question: List the top 5 highest rated products with verified customer reviews.
sql_pairs.sql: SELECT p.id, p.name, b.name AS brand, COUNT(pr.id) AS review_count, ROUND(AVG(pr.rating), 2) AS avg_rating FROM products p JOIN brands b ON p.brand_id = b.id JOIN product_reviews pr ON p.id = pr.product_id WHERE pr.status = 'approved' AND pr.is_verified_purchase = 1 GROUP BY p.id, p.name, b.name HAVING COUNT(pr.id) >= 2 ORDER BY avg_rating DESC, review_count DESC LIMIT 5;

sql_pairs.question: Show the distribution of product review ratings across 1 to 5 stars.
sql_pairs.sql: SELECT rating AS star_rating, COUNT(*) AS total_reviews, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_reviews WHERE status = 'approved'), 1) AS percentage FROM product_reviews WHERE status = 'approved' GROUP BY rating ORDER BY star_rating DESC;

sql_pairs.question: Which reviews received the highest number of helpful upvotes from the community?
sql_pairs.sql: SELECT pr.id, p.name AS product_name, CONCAT(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) AS reviewer, pr.rating, pr.title, pr.helpful_votes FROM product_reviews pr JOIN products p ON pr.product_id = p.id JOIN users u ON pr.user_id = u.id WHERE pr.status = 'approved' ORDER BY pr.helpful_votes DESC LIMIT 10;

sql_pairs.question: Find all verified reviews for products with 5-star rating.
sql_pairs.sql: SELECT pr.id, p.name AS product_name, pr.title, pr.review_text, pr.helpful_votes, pr.created_at FROM product_reviews pr JOIN products p ON pr.product_id = p.id WHERE pr.rating = 5 AND pr.is_verified_purchase = 1 AND pr.status = 'approved' ORDER BY pr.helpful_votes DESC LIMIT 10;

sql_pairs.question: What is the average rating given by reviewers for each brand?
sql_pairs.sql: SELECT b.name AS brand_name, COUNT(pr.id) AS total_reviews, ROUND(AVG(pr.rating), 2) AS avg_brand_rating FROM brands b JOIN products p ON b.id = p.brand_id JOIN product_reviews pr ON p.id = pr.product_id WHERE pr.status = 'approved' GROUP BY b.name HAVING COUNT(pr.id) >= 2 ORDER BY avg_brand_rating DESC LIMIT 10;

sql_pairs.question: How many total helpful votes were submitted across all product reviews?
sql_pairs.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_helpful_votes_cast, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS distinct_voting_users FROM review_helpful_votes WHERE is_helpful = 1;
